transcript_text: Agent: Thanks for holding. Can you tell me when the sync failures started? Customer: Right after the 3.2 firmware went out on Tuesday night. Every job after four in the morning fails with a connection reset. Agent: Understood. We have three other reports of the same pattern on 3.2. I am raising this as a priority two and rolling you back to 3.1 while engineering investigates. Customer: How long until the rollback takes effect? Agent: Within the hour, and I will call you back to confirm the overnight run succeeded.

Customer: Our entire production tenant is down, every call returns a 503 and we have four hundred users unable to work. Agent: I am seeing the incident on our status page, it opened at 09:12 UTC and affects the EU cluster. Customer: We breach our SLA at 10:12, what is the plan? Agent: Engineering has identified a failed load balancer node and is draining traffic to the secondary region. Estimated recovery is twenty five minutes. I am attaching your tenant to the incident so you receive updates automatically and I will send an RCA within five business days.

Customer: I have been charged twice for February, one hundred and forty nine dollars each time. Agent: I can see both charges, the second one was a retry that did not recognise the first authorisation. I am issuing a refund for the duplicate now. Customer: How long does that take? Agent: Five to seven business days depending on your bank, and I will email you the credit note today.

Customer: The box arrived empty, the tape was cut and there was nothing inside but padding. Agent: I am very sorry. Do you have photographs of the packaging and the seal? Customer: Yes, and the courier signature. Agent: Please reply to the case email with those, I am opening a loss claim with the carrier and sending a replacement today rather than waiting for the claim to close.

Customer: An employee left three weeks ago and her admin account is still active. Agent: That should have been removed by the offboarding automation. I am disabling the SSO account now and revoking her active sessions. Customer: We also need to know what she accessed since her last day. Agent: I will pull the audit log for that window and send it to your security contact within twenty four hours.

Customer: The Android app crashes the moment I open it. Agent: Which Android version are you on? Customer: Fifteen, on a Pixel. Agent: There is a known crash on Android 15 tied to the equaliser screen caching a null profile. The fix is in build 4.7.2 which releases Thursday. As a workaround, open the app in aeroplane mode once to reset the cached profile.
